# TheStrat

> A Polars library for explicit OHLCV aggregation, Strat bar classification and session-aware window geometry.

## Library documentation

- [API reference](docs/api.md): Public signatures, source coverage, frame schemas and validation.
- [Calculation and state behavior](docs/behavior.md): Snapshot replacement, classifications, sessions and caller responsibilities.
- [Executable examples](README.md): Step-by-step usage with checked outputs for each operation.

## Optional

- [Contributor instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository development and verification guidance for agents changing this library.
